assets.title: 单缝衍射与光程差
assets.author: OpenStax (Rice University)
tags: Light passing through a single slit is diffracted in all directions and may interfere constructively or destructively, depending on the angle. The difference in path length for rays from either side of the slit is seen to be D sin θ .

assets.title: 会聚透镜的虚像与光线追迹
assets.author: OpenStax (Rice University)
tags: Ray tracing predicts the image location and size for an object held closer to a converging lens than its focal length. Ray 1 enters parallel to the axis and exits through the focal point on the opposite side, while ray 2 passes through the center of the lens without changing path. The two rays continue to diverge on the other side of the lens, but both appear to come from a common point, locating the upright, magnified, virtual image. This is a case 2 image.

assets.title: 光纤包层与全反射
assets.author: OpenStax (Rice University)
tags: Fibers in bundles are clad by a material that has a lower index of refraction than the core to ensure total internal reflection, even when fibers are in contact with one another. This shows a single fiber with its cladding.
